+ Python file writing as a “virtual memory” layer for MetaBlooms. It won’t fix OpenAI’s frontend architecture, but it does fix our context bloat and lets us run the OS the way MetaMemoryLayer / SnapshotEngine expect. MetaBlooms lite
Think of it like this:

Chat window = fragile, laggy UI we can’t control.

Model context = expensive, should stay small.

/mnt/data + project files = our own disk-backed memory store that we control.
